title: Investigating the cytotoxicity and genotoxicity of Vortioxetine with in vivo and in silico methods.
authors: Cicekliyurt, Meliha Merve; Inan, Pinar; Gunay, Melih; Akkus, Gulsum; Cicekliyurt, Altug
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过体内外实验和分子对接考察抗抑郁药沃替西汀与DNA的结合及遗传毒性，虽涉及药物-DNA互作和对接方法，但对象为小分子药物而非蛋白质-DNA体系，且方法深度有限，仅部分可借鉴。
abstract: Vortioxetine is a multimodal antidepressant with reported benefits on cognitive functioning, social functioning, and fatigue, however its potential genotoxic risks have not been adequately studied. Therefore, this study aims to investigate the cytotoxicity and genotoxicity of vortioxetine in vivo and in silico. Genotoxic effects were assessed using Chromosome aberration (CA) and micronucleus (MN) assays in cultured human peripheral blood lymphocyte. Cytotoxicity was evaluated through Mitotic index (MI), and DNA interaction was analysed by UV titration and agarose gel electrophoresis. In silico analyses were performed with Attraction Cavities and AutoDock Vina methods. Experimental results demonstrate that vortioxetine binds to Calf Thymus DNA (CT-DNA) through intercalative interactions and cleaves pBR322 DNA in the presence of hydrogen peroxide. DNA binding studies indicated that groove binding is the effective interaction between vortioxetine and CT-DNA (Kb: 6.25 x 10(5) M(- 1)). It was also supported by molecular docking results, where binding affinities of vortioxetine and escitalopram were - 7.29 and - 7.69 kcal/mol for Attracting Cavities and - 6.01 and - 6.57 kcal/mol for AutoDock Vina. When comparing vortioxetine to escitalopram, both drugs were found to be potentially genotoxic. These findings suggest a potential genotoxic risk with prolonged use and provide valuable insight for clinicians in evaluating long-term safety.
abstract_zh: 沃替西汀是一种多模式抗抑郁药，据报道对认知功能、社会功能和疲劳有益，但其潜在的遗传毒性风险尚未得到充分研究。因此，本研究旨在通过体内和计算机模拟方法探讨沃替西汀的细胞毒性和遗传毒性。遗传毒性效应通过培养的人外周血淋巴细胞中的染色体畸变（CA）和微核（MN）试验进行评估。细胞毒性通过有丝分裂指数（MI）评估，DNA相互作用通过紫外滴定和琼脂糖凝胶电泳分析。计算机模拟分析采用Attraction Cavities和AutoDock Vina方法进行。实验结果表明，沃替西汀通过嵌入相互作用与小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）结合，并在过氧化氢存在下切割pBR322 DNA。DNA结合研究表明，沟槽结合是沃替西汀与CT-DNA之间的有效相互作用（Kb: 6.25 x 10(5) M(- 1)）。分子对接结果也支持这一结论，其中沃替西汀和艾司西酞普兰的结合亲和力在Attraction Cavities方法下分别为-7.29和-7.69 kcal/mol，在AutoDock Vina方法下分别为-6.01和-6.57 kcal/mol。将沃替西汀与艾司西酞普兰进行比较时，发现两种药物均具有潜在的遗传毒性。这些发现提示长期使用可能存在遗传毒性风险，并为临床医生评估长期安全性提供了有价值的见解。
